name: Auto-Block Correlated Attack
description: Automatically blocks the attacker IP when both Snort signature AND ML anomaly fire for the same source within the correlation window.

name: Block High-Confidence LSTM Threat
description: Blocks an IP only when the locally trained LSTM Autoencoder reports a high-confidence anomaly.

name: Block DNS Tunnel
description: Automatically blocks the source IP when a DNS tunneling attempt is detected.

name: Threat Score Auto-Quarantine
description: Blocks IP automatically when its cumulative threat score reaches or exceeds the quarantine threshold (default: 10).

name: Repeat High-Severity Snort Block
description: Blocks IP if Snort priority-1 rule fires 3+ times for same IP within 60 seconds.
